experiment: mem0 v2.2.1 head-to-head on 200 identical records
notes: LLM fact extraction returned malformed JSON for many records (parse errors logged); unparseable outputs were silently dropped, contributing to the hard ceiling. Phase 1 in a separate run initially produced 70 ADDs but the Qdrant collection was rebuilt with correct 384-dim embedding, resetting to the canonical 20-memory ceiling. The 0.10x ratio is consistent with the paper's prior claim from the October 2026 cross-system experiment.
